completion:
Then in a new document note the faults. If there are multiple faults that cause the appliance to fail, then note them all by typing them out (usually maximum 4 faults per appliance).
3. Then on the last appendix add the files (you will reuse this appendix for other devices with faults, remember to open as PDF).
4. Then from the drop-down menu click "pdf import"
5. Then click "document with forms" (second option is also fine) # Appendix: Signature Key
